**Finding: Deviation (high severity) — § 6(a), p0032**

The termination section fails the T4C position in both directions:

- **No Customer convenience right mid-engagement.** § 6(a)'s "for any or no reason" right is gated on there being *no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding*. Since § 2 (p0011) makes the term open-ended ("shall continue until terminated"), this is effectively a term longer than 12 months in which Clear Capital cannot exit an active engagement at will, and there is no pro-rata refund mechanic.
- **Vendor may walk on 15 days.** RadialSpark's convenience right sits well below the 90-day walk-away floor.

**Redline (validated, ok:true)** — single-paragraph replacement of § 6(a) that:
1. Adds a Company right to terminate the Agreement or any SOW, in whole or in part, on 30 days' notice, with refund of prepaid fees and liability limited to Services performed through the termination date; and
2. Retains the "no uncompleted Statement of Work" gate only for Contractor, and raises its notice to 90 days.

The comment offers 60 days as the fallback landing zone on our notice period.
